title: Phase 1: Export and Profile
goal: Know the week's export, the key policy, and what the vendor can tell you.
unlocks: The records and rules the matching reads.

title: Phase 2: Duplicate Detection
goal: Find candidate pairs by the key and decide which merge without a person.
unlocks: Sure merges and a steward queue.

title: Phase 3: Merge and Survivorship
goal: Fold duplicates into golden records without losing a field.
unlocks: The clean book the scoring reads.

title: Phase 4: Enrichment and Scoring
goal: Enrich every account from the vendor and score it with the model.

title: Phase 5: Routing and Report
goal: Route the hot leads, report the week, and keep the trend.
unlocks: A routed Monday and a report RevOps can read.
